metadata.title: Secure Survey Relying System SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan template for systems that create, embed, trigger, or depend on Secure Survey services.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: An application or service that relies on the Secure Survey Platform to conduct surveys without implementing survey consent, identity, or data protection mechanisms directly.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: This system relies on the Secure Survey Platform SSPP for survey execution, consent enforcement, identity handling, and response integrity.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: Where surveys involve external or research participants, this system relies on the External / Research Survey SSPP constraints.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: This system consumes identity services only for survey eligibility or access control, never for response analysis unless explicitly declared.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: This system relies on Secure Network for protected transport, availability, and monitoring.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: This system relies on Secure Email application send-only mechanisms for survey invitations and notifications.

props.name: survey-consumption-model
props.remarks: Survey consent, anonymity enforcement, and data protection are implemented by the Secure Survey Platform and are not re-implemented locally.

props.name: application-responsibility
props.remarks: The relying system remains responsible for defining survey purpose, audience, and justification.

props.name: data-governance-boundary
props.remarks: Survey responses and metadata are governed by the Secure Survey Platform, not by the relying application, unless explicitly transferred under policy.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Relying systems invoke survey services while preserving defined trust and responsibility boundaries.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Survey-related privacy and security controls are inherited from the Secure Survey SSPP stack.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP documents reliance on Secure Survey services and prohibits local implementation of survey trust semantics within the relying system.

components.title: Survey-Reliant Application Component
components.description: Logical representation of an application that initiates or embeds survey functionality.

roles.title: Application Owner
roles.remarks: Defines survey purpose, timing, and integration points within the application context.

roles.title: Survey Architecture Authority
roles.remarks: Ensures correct inheritance of Secure Survey controls and prevents survey logic duplication.

control-implementation.remarks: All survey security, privacy, consent, and data protection controls are inherited from the Secure Survey Platform and related SSPPs. This SSPP documents reliance and boundary conditions only.
